consumer: A crafting/tool-quality eligibility or has_amount/has_quality check that asks 'does the avatar possess one working multitool?' by calling the engine's possession count, not a panel render
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory on-person possession), including bionic pseudo-tools
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of — special-cases bionic pseudo-tools (BIONIC_TOOLS/fake-item bionics) then tallies real items via amount_of_internal, returning the engine's authoritative possession count
divergence: Avatar has an active tool-providing bionic that fakes a multitool but carries no physical one: write_carried_items emits a no-multitool array (re-derivation answers 'no'), while amount_of(multitool, pseudo=true) returns 1 — the engine predicate answers 'yes'
